title: Full Track 1 candidate remeasure with Swing causal D-1
decision_rationale: same-day Swing is not live-tradable: the label is computed from the session's close and does not exist during the 14:05-15:55 window
so the choice is D-1 or nothing, not same-day vs D-1
under D-1 the sleeve is weaker in every window and turns negative in the most recent OOS window (2026: -$464 vs +$719)
but its parameters AND its R4 context filter thresholds were selected under the same-day labels, so this is new labels through an old filter
not good enough to enter paper as it stands; not established as worthless either
baseline_match: 30 of 30 numbers, from a fresh run

confirmed_inputs.source: each window's own recorded argv inside the promotion artifact, not a CLI default

variant.changed: the labels object handed to SwingTFEngine.backtest_basket, wrapped in RegimeLabels(lag_days=1)

results.arithmetic_check: the net delta is the same dollar figure under both policies in every window; the Calm-NKD switch adds a contribution this change does not touch

sleeve_contribution_booked_after_caps.note: Stress and NKD move by exactly zero in all six cells; Calm moves slightly through same-symbol interaction with Swing, which is real and not leakage

swing_specifics.sign_inversion: 2025 is BETTER by $1,081 before portfolio caps and WORSE by $784 after them; judging the sleeve standalone would have inverted the answer

answers.same_day_reason: the label is computed from the session's close and is published after the 14:05-15:55 window ends
answers.d1_swing_worth_keeping: not established - positive in floor and 2025, negative in 2026, and untuned under the causal label
answers.paper_route_recommendation: disable Swing, retune under D-1 before reconsidering
answers.disable_is_operationally_neutral: Stage 5ZZZ-G measured that live Swing already refuses every session; disabling makes an existing silence explicit
answers.retune_is_not_curve_fitting: the original selection was made on an information set the live route cannot have; re-running the same walk-forward on valid inputs is redoing it, not fitting it. No parameter values are proposed.

caveats: floor is in-sample and carries the largest delta - the weakest evidence
2026 is eight months and 45 taken trades; no confidence interval was computed
the R4 context filter thresholds were fit under same-day labels, so this is new labels through an old filter and is not a fair test of D-1 as a design
one regeneration per window; no bootstrap, no sensitivity sweep

a concurrency mistake produced a spurious baseline floor of $66,796 when the replay was re-run while the regeneration was overwriting shared artifacts; caught by sha256, repeated cleanly, all thirty numbers returned

safety.only_baseline_script_edit: an additive per-cluster P&L accumulator, read by nothing in the control flow; proved harmless by re-running and matching all thirty baseline numbers
